'''ZeHeth''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[ZeHethbra]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The natives of ZeHeth lived in [[City/Legends|urban]] areas as well as in dens amid the roots of the planet's large [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. ZeHeth was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and became a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] afterward.

==Description==
ZeHeth was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="UAA" /> located in the [[ZeHeth system/Legends|ZeHeth system]], a part of the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA ZeHeth" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], between the [[Malastare system]] and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Pax system/Legends|Pax system]].<ref name="TEA ZeHeth" /> A [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] world,<ref name="UAA" /> ZeHeth had [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] regions in its northern hemisphere.<ref name="AE" /> The planet's [[Plant/Legends|flora]] included large [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
Between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], ZeHeth was situated outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], constituting a part of the poorly-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] region known as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding ZeHeth became explored between [[8000 BBY]] and [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]], and the planet was a part of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA ZeHeth" /> with the Republic's [[Seventeenth Army|Seventeenth Sector Army]] being charged with defending ZeHeth's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the first campaigns of that conflict. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], ZeHeth fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|ZeHethbra}}
ZeHeth was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[ZeHethbra]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which communicated in the [[Zehethbra]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. The ZeHethbra inhabited either ZeHeth's [[City/Legends|urban]] sprawls or rural dens constructed amid the roots of their homeworld's trees.<ref name="UAA" /> Due to their planet's varied ecosystems, the ZeHethbra developed at least eighty distinct cultural, racial, and ethnic groups,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|369|ZeHethbra}}</ref> with the ZeHethbra inhabiting ZeHeth's northern hemisphere commonly having [[Color/Legends|brown]]- or red-colored [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and the natives of the planet's southern polar region being blue-white in color.<ref name="AE" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the ZeHeth [[Star system/Legends|system]] numbered between 500 million and one billion.<ref name="TEA ZeHeth" /> The ZeHethbra eventually traveled throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="AE" /> [[Colonist/Legends|settling]] many other worlds<ref name="UAA" /> and becoming well-known as a species.<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZeHeth was first mentioned in the [[1994]] ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> The name of the planet was consistently misspelled as "Zeheth" in the [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''.<ref name="UAA" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the ZeHeth system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square N-16.<ref name="TEA ZeHeth" />
